prompt: How does blood tests show anemia
judge_reasoning: Candidate 3 most directly answers how blood test results show anemia by linking CBC indices (MCV, hemoglobin/hematocrit patterns) and iron/B12-related tests to anemia types (microcytic/iron deficiency vs macrocytic/B12 deficiency). Candidate 1 is also on-topic and detailed, but includes more specific numeric “normal” cutoffs (e.g., RBC reference thresholds) that are more likely to be inaccurate. Candidate 2 focuses mainly on symptoms rather than explaining which blood test values indicate anemia. Candidate 4 largely discusses imaging and other procedures that are not blood tests, so it is substantially off-target.
